name: Flushing Open AM 2024
information: This is a series competition with [Flushing Open PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlushingOpenPM2024). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Flushing Open PM 2024, your registration for this competition will be rejected.
